metadata.title: AI and Robotics Are a Battleground for U.S. and China. This Is the Best Bet.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
AI and Robotics Are a Battleground for U.S. and China. This Is the Best Bet.
Wall Street is always searching for the next big thing, and the latest mega IPO in Shanghai is tantalizing for investors—but they shouldn’t give up on U.S. stocks just yet.
